title: Approval of a Task Order Amendment to Contract DA-5789 with Austin Commercial LP: Covering Gateway 1 construction for not to exceed $99,400,000; and appropriation of not to exceed $117,586,656 for the
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a Task Order Amendment to Contract DA-5789 with Austin Commercial LP: Covering Gateway 1 construction for not to exceed $99,400,000; and appropriation of not to exceed $117,586,656 for the Los Angeles International Airport Gateway Project (Jacob Adams)
summary: Authorizes a task order amendment with Austin Commercial for Gateway 1 construction at LAX, up to $99.4 million, and appropriates up to $117.6 million for the LAX Gateway Project.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
